report_metadata.data_caveat: Pre-signal account: 2 purchases on $1,651.69 (blended CPA $825.85), 61% of spend under Incremental attribution. Every creative/demographic read below is validation_required — this map organizes hypotheses for the initial MST, it does not declare winners.

icp_profiles.profile_name: Young Adult Gift Buyer (buying FOR parent/partner)
icp_profiles.demographic_foundation: Male 25-34 — the account's 8th-largest segment ($123.70 spend, 6,835 impressions) yet it produced 1 of the 2 account purchases (2026-06-21, on the gift-narrative creative '1 Print Static'). Buyer is not the recipient: the purchase creative is written entirely about someone else's street.
icp_profiles.psychographic_profile: Shopping for an emotionally meaningful, non-generic gift for a parent or partner. Responds to recipient-reaction narratives ('watch their face light up'), not product specs or discounts. Gift anxiety — wants the gift to land, fears giving something forgettable.
icp_profiles.behavioral_signals: Converted on HK_Story + HK_Shock hook ('made a grown man cry' lineage) with a precisely-named street in the artwork. Zero purchases from this segment on catalog/offer creative despite broader delivery.
icp_profiles.funnel_entry_point: TOFU — cold, problem-aware gift seekers around gifting moments (Father's Day window in the data).
icp_profiles.message_resonance: Emotional gift narrative (LD-CN-GIFT-MOMENT). The converting ad spent $107.24 total — the account's best purchase-per-dollar signal.
icp_profiles.strategic_recommendation: Primary ICP for MST cycle 1. Run gift-narrative cells broad and let delivery re-find younger gift buyers; do not hard-restrict age yet (delivery skew currently sends 52% of spend to 55+).

icp_profiles.demographic_foundation: 55+ segments absorbed $851.70 (51.6% of account spend, ~24,400 impressions) and produced 1 purchase: female 55-64 on 'Multiple Pieces' (2026-05-06) — an authentic multi-print product spread with no discount overlay.
icp_profiles.psychographic_profile: Decorating their own home with meaningful places — cities of first trips, honeymoons, hometowns. Values perceived craftsmanship ('museum-quality paper', real wood frames) and authenticity; a real unstyled photo outperformed the polished discount grid for this segment.
icp_profiles.behavioral_signals: Converted on PR_Demonstration (real photo of framed prints leaned on furniture) with rational catalog-breadth copy. Zero purchases from the same segments on the 25%-off catalog grid ($364.86, 0 purchases account-wide).
icp_profiles.funnel_entry_point: TOFU/MOFU — solution-aware browsers; testimonial and quality-proof creative are natural MOFU/BOFU follow-ups for this ICP.
icp_profiles.message_resonance: Authentic product spread (LD-CN-PRODUCT-SPREAD) — real photo, no overlay, no discount. Secondary winning-stack hypothesis from analysis_core.
icp_profiles.strategic_recommendation: Secondary ICP for MST cycle 1. A/B real-photo spread vs catalog-grid mockup at equal budget with NO discount in either arm, per the analysis_core next-sprint recommendation.

icp_profiles.demographic_foundation: No converting segment yet. The two city-pride creatives ('Music Row Static - Pride' static + 'Blue Shirt UGC') spent $287.28 across 7,578 impressions with 0 reported purchases.
icp_profiles.psychographic_profile: Identity-driven local — buys the city as a badge ('NASHVILLE ART for a NASHVILLE LOVER'). Neighborhood name-stacking (Music Row, 12 South, Belle Meade) is the flattery mechanic.
icp_profiles.behavioral_signals: None validated. Analysis_core flags that broad (non-geo-targeted) delivery likely wasted the geo-specific message — the concept is untested, not disproven.
icp_profiles.funnel_entry_point: TOFU — geo-targeted cold audiences in the named city only.
icp_profiles.message_resonance: Unproven. City-pride creative must be re-tested geo-tight before the concept is judged.
icp_profiles.strategic_recommendation: Hold out of MST cycle 1 budget. Run a separate geo-tight Nashville test before spending against this ICP again — do not kill on 0 purchases until attribution is reconciled.

message_pillars.strategic_purpose: Turn a street into the protagonist of the recipient's life story. The gift lands because the place means something — the emotional core of the brand and the source of the account's best purchase-per-dollar signal.
message_pillars.funnel_application: TOFU cold gift seekers; occasion overlays (Father's Day, anniversary, housewarming) are cycle-2 extensions of this pillar.
message_pillars.performance_evidence: Pillar ads ('1 Print Static', '2 Print Static', '2 Print + Dads Gift'): $141.69 spend, 4,254 impressions, 1 of 2 account purchases. The converting ad alone: $107.24, 3,160 impressions, CPA $107.24 — vs $364.86 / 0 purchases on the discount grid. Validation_required (single purchase, mixed attribution).
message_pillars.execution_specifications: Static, warm lifestyle photography, single print staged in a domestic scene, precisely-named street visible in the artwork, short copy (2-4 lines), recipient-reaction narrative, implicit personalization CTA ('Find his city'). Single copy variant per test cell — copy fragmentation (15-29 variants/ad) destroyed isolation in the historical window.
message_pillars.placement_strategy: Directional only — conversion-based device export (2026-01-01 → 2026-07-09, wider than the demo window): link clicks skew 94.5% mobile (iphone 932 + android 211 + tablets 83 of 1,298); Feed carries 941 link clicks; the account's single tracked-checkout purchase path ran through Instagram Stories. No placement spend/impressions exist under conversion tracking, so no placement CPA/CTR — run broad placements; treat these splits as delivery hints, not performance reads.
message_pillars.scaling_guidance: Scale-test candidate per analysis_core, but nothing scales from this window: validate through MST cycle 1 (gift-moment 3x3) first. No cell above 5% of budget for unproven variants.

message_pillars.strategic_purpose: Neutralize the 'is this just a cheap poster?' objection with spec proof: heavyweight fine-art paper, archival inks, real wood frames, guarantee.
message_pillars.funnel_application: BOFU retargeting — objection rebuttal for browsers who didn't buy.
message_pillars.performance_evidence: 'Good quality ad' (retargeting): $127.33, 3,286 impressions, 0 purchases. Analysis_core flags the retargeting pool size as unverified — the read is 'optimize after pool-size check', not 'failed'. Validation_required.
message_pillars.execution_specifications: Macro product close-up (frame corner, paper texture), 'not a poster' spec language, guarantee + free shipping reassurance, dark-macro design system.
message_pillars.placement_strategy: Unknown — placement metrics unavailable in this window.
message_pillars.scaling_guidance: 25% of budget to BOFU quality-rebuttal retargeting AFTER the pool-size check, per budget guidance. Do not scale prospecting with this pillar.

message_pillars.strategic_purpose: Any place that matters is printable — hometown, college town, honeymoon coast. Breadth is the rational proof that the buyer's specific place exists in the catalog.
message_pillars.funnel_application: TOFU/MOFU solution-aware browsers; the authentic-spread execution carries the pillar, the discount-grid execution is quarantined.
message_pillars.performance_evidence: Pillar splits cleanly in the data: authentic spread ('Multiple Pieces' + '6 Images') $255.03, 15,174 impressions, 1 purchase (CPA $172.38 on the converting ad) — while the 25%-off catalog grid ('9 Image + Discount') burned $364.86 / 11,797 impressions / 0 purchases. Breadth converts when proven authentically, not via discount overlay. Validation_required.
message_pillars.execution_specifications: Real (non-mockup) photo of 5-9 framed prints leaned on furniture, catalog-breadth copy ('cities, coasts, and countries'), craftsmanship cues ('museum-quality paper'), NO discount overlay.
message_pillars.placement_strategy: Unknown — placement metrics unavailable in this window.
message_pillars.scaling_guidance: Part of the 60% validate allocation: A/B real-photo spread vs catalog-grid mockup at equal budget, no discount in either arm. Hold discount executions at ≤15% of budget pending attribution reconciliation.

message_pillars.funnel_application: TOFU, geo-targeted only. Broad delivery wastes the geo-specific flattery (LD-H3).
message_pillars.performance_evidence: 'Music Row Static - Pride' $233.55 / 6,476 impressions and 'Blue Shirt UGC' $53.73 / 1,102 impressions — $287.28 combined, 0 reported purchases across static and UGC formats. Untested geo-tight; do not judge the concept on broad delivery. Validation_required.
message_pillars.execution_specifications: One city per creative, neighborhood name-stack ('Music Row. Lower Broad. East Nash.'), local-identity call-out headline, lifestyle mockup or UGC talking-head format.
message_pillars.placement_strategy: Unknown — placement metrics unavailable in this window.

testing_hypotheses.statement: Emotional gift-moment narrative (HK_Story/HK_Shock + TN_Emotional + precisely-named street) outconverts offer-led catalog creative for cold traffic.
testing_hypotheses.test_variant: Gift-moment MST cells: hook (Story/Shock vs Question vs Stat) x concept staging (kitchen gift scene vs unwrap moment vs recipient reaction), single copy variant per cell
testing_hypotheses.isolated_variable: Hook type x concept staging (copy architecture held constant)
testing_hypotheses.sample_requirement: >= 30 purchases per read after attribution is unified to 7DC/1DV, or a reconciled server-side purchase count per cell
testing_hypotheses.duration: 14-day read windows per cell, standard attribution
testing_hypotheses.success_criteria: Gift-narrative cells beat the discount-grid control lineage on CPA at reconciled attribution; directional target: any cell CPA below the $107.24 historical single-purchase benchmark
testing_hypotheses.risk: Historical signal is n=1 purchase under mixed attribution — the control benchmark itself is validation_required
testing_hypotheses.expected_impact: Confirms the account's primary creative direction and unlocks cycle-2 occasion overlays (Father's Day analog, anniversary, housewarming)
testing_hypotheses.failure_plan: If no gift cell produces a purchase at 2x the historical CPA benchmark spend, fall back to the product-spread lane (LD-H2 secondary stack) as the primary direction

testing_hypotheses.statement: Two buyer paths exist: young gift buyers (25-34) respond to recipient-story creative; 55+ self-decorators respond to authentic product spreads. Messaging should split by ICP.
testing_hypotheses.test_variant: A/B: real-photo product spread vs catalog-grid mockup at equal budget, NO discount in either arm; run gift-narrative cells broad in parallel and watch which segments deliver purchases
testing_hypotheses.isolated_variable: Authenticity of product proof (real photo vs mockup), demographic delivery left broad
testing_hypotheses.sample_requirement: >= 30 purchases per arm at unified attribution; segment-level reads need reconciled server-side counts
testing_hypotheses.success_criteria: Purchases cluster by ICP as predicted (gift narrative -> 25-34 buyers, authentic spread -> 55+), and real-photo beats mockup on CPA
testing_hypotheses.risk: 52% of historical spend already skews 55+ — Advantage+ delivery may not re-find younger gift buyers without explicit budget separation
testing_hypotheses.expected_impact: Validates the two-ICP structure that the whole strategy map is built on
testing_hypotheses.failure_plan: If purchases don't split by ICP, collapse to a single blended audience strategy and rebuild ICPs from the converged segment data

testing_hypotheses.statement: Geo-specific city pride works only when geo-targeted tightly; broad delivery wastes it.
testing_hypotheses.control: Music Row Static - Pride ($233.55, 0 purchases on broad delivery)
testing_hypotheses.test_variant: Same city-pride creative re-run against Nashville-metro-only geo targeting
testing_hypotheses.isolated_variable: Geo targeting radius (broad vs city-tight), creative held constant
testing_hypotheses.sample_requirement: Enough Nashville-metro delivery for >= 15 purchases-equivalent signal at reconciled attribution; pool size must be verified first
testing_hypotheses.duration: 14-day read window after geo pool verification
testing_hypotheses.success_criteria: Geo-tight delivery produces any purchase signal where broad delivery produced none on $287.28
testing_hypotheses.risk: Nashville metro pool may be too small for statistical reads at current budget levels; targeting data was unavailable in the historical export
testing_hypotheses.expected_impact: Decides whether city-pride becomes a scalable per-city playbook or gets shelved
testing_hypotheses.failure_plan: Shelve LD-PILLAR-CITY-PRIDE and reallocate its budget share to the validated gift/spread lanes
